newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese armed police fan out along HK border.
newsitem.headline: Chinese armed police fan out along HK border.

text.p: Chinese paramilitary police in riot gear fanned out along the border with Hong Kong late on Monday, apparently to maintain order and prevent excited Chinese from trying to enter the territory after the midnight handover.

Hundreds of People's Armed Police, equipped with riot shields and dressed in combat fatigues and metal helmets, formed a human wall along the approach to the border crossing as soon as the first contingent of People's Liberation Army troops departed to enter Hong Kong.

The paramilitary personnel raced out of buildings near the border crossing point as hundreds of excited Chinese waved and cheered the departing troops, who will take up the defence of Hong Kong from midnight (1600 GMT).
China is anxious to prevent any influx of fortune-seekers into Hong Kong after the British colony returns to Chinese sovereignty.
Officials also fear that excited Chinese, unaware that the handover brings no change in tight immigration controls, may try to cross the border into Hong Kong after midnight.
Hong Kong police and Chinese authorities have joined forces in recent weeks to halt a surge in illegal immigrants into Hong Kong from China's neighbouring Guangdong province.
British forces, which had been patrolling the Hong Kong side of the border, have been withdrawn from the territory.
